A few things to know

Before you jump in.

Is the community really free?

Yes. Joining the UGC University community is free. You don’t need to buy a course or enroll in coaching to join.

Can I join if I’m new to UGC?

Yes. You don’t need an existing portfolio or a paid brand deal. Bring your curiosity and a willingness to learn and contribute.

What if I already create UGC?

You’re welcome here too. Connect with other creators, share your experience, and compare notes on what you’re working on.

Where does the community live?

On Discord. You’ll need a Discord account to accept the invite and participate in the server.

Does joining guarantee paid deals?

No. The community is a place to connect and learn. Paid opportunities and earnings depend on your work, experience, and the market.
